points.S2: 实验室气瓶固定与标识
points.S3: 焊接烟尘弧光防职业病
points.S5: 手持电动工具的振动与姿势

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着焊接面罩掀起来，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot lifts a welding face shield up from its face and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天用十道题，聊聊动火作业安全。

shots.scene: 一行图标：火焰、气瓶、砂轮、焊枪
shots.prompt_en: A row of simple icons: a flame, a gas cylinder, a grinding wheel and a welding torch. No people.
shots.narration: 气割、焊接、打磨，都会产生明火火花。

shots.scene: 实验楼走廊，老李推着焊接设备小车走来
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pushes a cart with welding equipment and two gas cylinders along a laboratory building corridor.
shots.narration: 实验楼要改造，老李来焊接维修管道。

shots.scene: 阿杰好奇地跟在后面
shots.prompt_en: The young male student follows the facility engineer curiously.
shots.narration: 阿杰在金工实习用过砂轮，想来帮忙。

shots.scene: 王老师递给老李一张空白审批单，老李点头
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands a blank permit form to the facility engineer, who nods.
shots.narration: 王老师先核对动火审批，才许开工。

shots.scene: 老李对阿杰竖起手指，示意先学再动手
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer raises one finger to the young male student, telling him to learn first.
shots.narration: 老李说：先答对这十道题再说。

shots.scene: 气割割炬、软管、气瓶连成一线，火焰往回窜的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram: a cutting torch, a hose and a gas cylinder in a line, with a red arrow of flame running back toward the cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：火焰往气源方向倒窜叫回火。

shots.scene: 箭头冲到气瓶处，爆炸图标闪现
shots.prompt_en: The red arrow reaches the cylinder and a small explosion warning icon flashes. No people.
shots.narration: 回火烧进软管、气瓶，后果严重。

shots.scene: 软管接口处装上一个小圆柱装置，红箭头被挡住
shots.prompt_en: A small cylindrical device is fitted at the hose connection and the red arrow is stopped there. No people.
shots.narration: 所以气路上要装回火防止器。

shots.scene: 欣欣点头，指着装置
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods and points at the small device on the hose.
shots.narration: 答案是回火防止器，别被相似名字骗。

shots.scene: 两只气瓶，一只直立一只横躺
shots.prompt_en: Two gas cylinders: one standing upright, one lying on its side on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：气瓶该怎么放？

shots.scene: 横躺的气瓶打红叉
shots.prompt_en: The cylinder lying on its side is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 横放容易滚动，碰坏瓶阀。

shots.scene: 直立的气瓶被链条固定在墙边，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The upright cylinder is secured to the wall with a chain and gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是直立，并且固定牢靠。

shots.scene: 砂轮机和一片砂轮，旁边两个转速表图标
shots.prompt_en: A bench grinder and a grinding wheel with two blank dial gauge icons beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：机器转速和砂轮额定转速比？

shots.scene: 砂轮碎裂飞出的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a grinding wheel shattering with flying pieces, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 机器转得比砂轮允许的还快，砂轮会碎。

shots.scene: 机器转速表指针低于砂轮转速表，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The machine dial needle sits below the wheel dial needle, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是等于或小于砂轮的额定转速。

shots.scene: 老李核对砂轮上的空白标签和机器铭牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer compares a blank label on a grinding wheel with the blank nameplate of the grinder.
shots.narration: 换砂轮前，先核对两边的标示。

shots.scene: 老李站在气瓶前，手拿空白检查表
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands beside a gas cylinder holding a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 第四题：气瓶用前要查哪些？

shots.scene: 瓶帽和阀门专用扳手的图标，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cylinder cap and a valve wrench, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶帽和阀门扳手要齐全。

shots.scene: 软管接头上涂肥皂水，冒出小气泡
shots.prompt_en: Soapy water brushed on a hose connection shows small bubbles. No people.
shots.narration: 用肥皂水查漏，冒泡就是漏气。

shots.scene: 接头处的回火防止器，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The flashback device at the hose connection gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 回火防止器也要装好。

shots.scene: 明火靠近接头的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lighter flame held near a hose connection, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 千万不能用明火去试漏。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起写着勾的卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a card with three check marks.
shots.narration: 答案是以上都要，一项不能少。

shots.scene: 一片砂轮挂在手指上，小锤轻敲，音符飘出
shots.prompt_en: A grinding wheel hangs from a finger while a small wooden mallet taps it lightly; music notes float out. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：砂轮装前怎么检查？

shots.scene: 清脆的音符与沉闷的音符对比
shots.prompt_en: Clear bright music notes on one side and dull broken notes on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 声音清脆是好的，发闷可能有裂纹。

shots.scene: 有裂纹的砂轮被放进报废箱
shots.prompt_en: A cracked grinding wheel is placed into a scrap box. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是敲击检查，有裂纹立即报废。

shots.scene: 一把电钻，旁边三个图标：双方框、手掌、电缆
shots.prompt_en: A power drill with three icons beside it: a double square symbol, an open hand and a cable. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：电动工具要具备什么？

shots.scene: 手柄外壳上出现两层颜色的剖面
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of the tool handle shows two separate insulating layers. No people.
shots.narration: 双重绝缘，漏电也不会传到手上。

shots.scene: 手松开开关，工具立即停止的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand releasing a trigger and the tool stopping instantly. No people.
shots.narration: 松手即停，失手时工具不会乱转。

shots.scene: 完好的电缆打勾，破皮电缆打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An intact cable with a green check beside a cable with damaged insulation crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电缆绝缘完好，破皮的停用。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 答案是三样都要具备。

shots.scene: 气瓶存放间，阴凉通风，有百叶窗
shots.prompt_en: A cool gas cylinder storage room with louvered vents and upright chained cylinders. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：气瓶该存在哪里？

shots.scene: 气瓶远离一桶溶剂，箭头标出距离
shots.prompt_en: Cylinders placed far from a drum of flammable liquid with a long arrow between them. No people.
shots.narration: 远离可燃物，避免火灾时火上浇油。

shots.scene: 焊接火花飞溅区与气瓶之间隔开
shots.prompt_en: A welding spark zone separated from the cylinders by a fire-resistant screen. No people.
shots.narration: 远离动火点，火花不能溅到气瓶。

shots.scene: 太阳晒着气瓶的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the sun shining on a cylinder, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 受热会升压，阴凉通风最要紧。

shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods.
shots.narration: 答案是以上都对。

shots.scene: 焊机、焊钳和工件，回路线夹在工件旁边
shots.prompt_en: A welding machine with its return cable clamped right next to the workpiece. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：焊机回路线接在哪里？

shots.scene: 回路线夹在远处的管道上，电流箭头绕远路，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A return cable clamped to a distant pipe with a long winding current arrow, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 随便夹在远处金属上，电流会乱走。

shots.scene: 电流箭头穿过管道和栏杆，冒出火花
shots.prompt_en: A current arrow running through a pipe and a railing with small sparks. No people.
shots.narration: 可能引起意外打火、发热和触电。

shots.scene: 老李把回路线夹在工件旁，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer clamps the return cable right next to the workpiece; a green check appears.
shots.narration: 答案是接在离工件最近的地方。

shots.scene: 气瓶阀门旁的安全泄压装置特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a small pressure relief device beside a cylinder valve. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：气瓶安全泄压装置做什么？

shots.scene: 压力表指针升高，装置喷出一股气
shots.prompt_en: A blank gauge needle rises and the relief device releases a puff of gas. No people.
shots.narration: 压力过高时自动泄压，

shots.scene: 气瓶被火烤热，装置放出气体
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder heated by nearby flames releases gas through the relief device. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶过热时放出气体，防止爆裂。

shots.scene: 装置上贴着禁止触碰的图标
shots.prompt_en: A do-not-touch prohibition pictogram beside the relief device. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是两者都对，不许随意拆改。

shots.scene: 焊接现场的三个图标：强光、火花、烟雾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons around a welding spot: a bright light burst, flying sparks and a gray fume cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：焊接会产生哪些危害？

shots.scene: 强光图标射向眼睛图标
shots.prompt_en: A bright light burst icon pointing at an eye icon. No people.
shots.narration: 弧光伤眼睛，也会灼伤皮肤。

shots.scene: 火花落到纸箱上冒烟
shots.prompt_en: Sparks landing on a cardboard box start a small wisp of smoke. No people.
shots.narration: 火花飞溅，可能引燃周围物品。

shots.scene: 灰色烟雾飘向人形图标的口鼻
shots.prompt_en: A gray fume cloud drifting toward the nose and mouth of a person icon. No people.
shots.narration: 烟尘有毒，吸进去伤肺。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起三张卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up three cards together.
shots.narration: 答案是以上都有。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，台上有酒精灯、加热板、热风枪、电烙铁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab bench with an alcohol burner, a hot plate, a heat gun and a soldering iron on it.
shots.narration: 实验室里也有不少明火和高温热源。

shots.scene: 热源旁边的溶剂瓶被移开
shots.prompt_en: A closed solvent bottle is moved away from a heat source on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 使用时，把易燃试剂移远。

shots.scene: 小研离开前关掉加热板，拔下插头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches off a hot plate and unplugs it before leaving.
shots.narration: 人离开要断电，不能无人值守。

shots.scene: 实验楼里的焊接作业，王老师在审批单上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank permit form beside a welding area in the lab building.
shots.narration: 楼里要焊接切割，必须先办审批。

shots.section_title: 实验室气瓶固定与标识
shots.scene: 实验室墙边，气瓶用链条固定在支架上
shots.prompt_en: In a laboratory, gas cylinders are chained to a wall-mounted bracket. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室气瓶，要固定在支架上。
overlay: 实验室气瓶固定与标识

shots.section_title: 实验室气瓶固定与标识
shots.scene: 气瓶上挂着空白状态牌：满瓶、使用中、空瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Cylinders with blank status tags showing full, in-use and empty icons. No people.
shots.narration: 挂好状态牌，满、用、空分清。

shots.section_title: 实验室气瓶固定与标识
shots.scene: 不同颜色的气瓶并排
shots.prompt_en: Cylinders of different body colors standing side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶身颜色按国家标准，以现行文本为准。

shots.section_title: 实验室气瓶固定与标识
shots.scene: 可燃气瓶和氧气瓶分开放置
shots.prompt_en: A flammable gas cylinder and an oxygen cylinder placed apart, separated by a wall. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃气体和助燃气体要分开放。

shots.section_title: 实验室气瓶固定与标识
shots.scene: 老李用气瓶推车运送
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer moves a cylinder on a cylinder hand truck.
shots.narration: 搬运用专用推车，戴好瓶帽。

shots.section_title: 焊接烟尘弧光防职业病
shots.scene: 老李戴焊接面罩、手套，开着局部排风
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears a welding face shield and gloves, with a local exhaust hood near the work.
shots.narration: 焊接烟尘和弧光，会导致职业病。
overlay: 焊接烟尘弧光防职业病

shots.section_title: 焊接烟尘弧光防职业病
shots.scene: 肺部图标和眼睛图标，带警示
shots.prompt_en: A lungs icon and an eye icon, each with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 长期吸烟尘伤肺，弧光会伤眼。

shots.section_title: 焊接烟尘弧光防职业病
shots.scene: 排风罩把烟雾吸走
shots.prompt_en: A local exhaust hood draws the gray fumes away from the work. No people.
shots.narration: 先用排风，再戴好防护用品。

shots.section_title: 焊接烟尘弧光防职业病
shots.scene: 阿杰站在旁边，被欣欣用屏风挡住
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot places a welding screen between the young male student and the welding area.
shots.narration: 旁观的人也会被弧光伤到，要设屏挡。

shots.section_title: 焊接烟尘弧光防职业病
shots.scene: 法律书和体检图标
shots.prompt_en: A closed blank law book and a health check clipboard icon. No people.
shots.narration: 职业病防治法要求告知、防护和体检。

shots.scene: 焊接时，阿杰手拿灭火器在旁边看火
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands nearby holding a fire extinguisher, watching the welding area.
shots.narration: 动火时要有专人看火，备好灭火器。

shots.scene: 周围可燃物被移走或用防火毯盖住
shots.prompt_en: Nearby combustible items are removed and the rest covered with a fire blanket. No people.
shots.narration: 开工前清走或遮盖周围可燃物。

shots.scene: 完工后老李检查地面缝隙和墙后
shots.prompt_en: After finishing, the facility engineer checks floor gaps and behind a wall for hidden embers.
shots.narration: 完工后检查缝隙和隔墙背面。

shots.scene: 时钟图标走过一段时间，阿杰再巡查一遍
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon advances while the young male student walks back to recheck the area.
shots.narration: 火星可能阴燃，过一阵再查一遍。

shots.section_title: 手持电动工具的振动与姿势
shots.scene: 阿杰双手握角磨机，肩膀耸起，手臂上有振动波纹
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds an angle grinder with raised shoulders; vibration waves run along his arms.
shots.narration: 长时间用手持电动工具，手臂受振动。
overlay: 手持电动工具的振动与姿势

shots.section_title: 手持电动工具的振动与姿势
shots.scene: 手指发白发麻的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of fingers turning pale with tingling marks. No people.
shots.narration: 久了手指发白发麻，可能患振动病。

shots.section_title: 手持电动工具的振动与姿势
shots.scene: 工件被夹在台虎钳上，阿杰站直操作
shots.prompt_en: The workpiece is clamped in a bench vise and the young male student works standing upright.
shots.narration: 工件夹牢放在合适高度，别弯腰硬撑。

shots.section_title: 手持电动工具的振动与姿势
shots.scene: 阿杰戴防振手套，放下工具休息
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears anti-vibration gloves and sets the tool down to rest.
shots.narration: 选低振工具，分段作业勤休息。

shots.scene: 气瓶接头冒出气体，阿杰闻到异味捂鼻
shots.prompt_en: Gas leaks from a cylinder connection and the young male student covers his nose.
shots.narration: 闻到气味、听到嘶嘶声，可能漏气。

shots.scene: 老李关闭气瓶阀门的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand closing a cylinder valve. No people.
shots.narration: 能安全够到就关阀，熄灭周围火源。

shots.scene: 开关和插头打红叉的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a light switch and a plug crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别开关电器，防止打火。

shots.scene: 众人撤到楼外，保卫处值班员接电话
shots.prompt_en: People evacuate outside the building while the security officer answers a phone.
shots.narration: 人员撤离，报告负责人和保卫处。

shots.scene: 电话图标，写着119
shots.prompt_en: A large telephone icon with a flame symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 起火了立即拨打119。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上气瓶、砂轮、焊枪三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard showing a cylinder, a grinding wheel and a welding torch icon.
shots.narration: 气瓶直立固定，用前查漏防回火。

shots.scene: 砂轮和电钻的图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a grinding wheel and a power drill with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 砂轮不超速敲击查，工具双重绝缘。

shots.scene: 焊接区有排风、屏风和看火人
shots.prompt_en: A welding area with a local exhaust hood, a screen and a fire watcher. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接防光防烟，动火审批有人看火。

shots.scene: 阿杰放下工具伸展手臂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts down a tool and stretches his arms.
shots.narration: 手持工具防振动，姿势放舒展。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别，身后是整齐固定的气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of neatly chained gas cylinders.
shots.narration: 火花虽小，规矩要大！
